about.title: Introduction
about.p1: Virender Choudhary's life is a story of values where success is measured by responsibility towards society. Through his actions, he has made honesty, service, and dedication his core principles. His deep sensitivity towards social concerns is clearly visible in every decision and effort. His continuous endeavor for the upliftment of every section of society reflects his visionary leadership. He believes that development is truly meaningful only when its benefits reach the last person. His life inspires us that true success is one that moves forward taking society along.
about.p2: With his experience, knowledge, and sensitive approach, Virender Choudhary has made public service not just a duty but the very purpose of his life. He believes that positive change is only possible through dialogue, participation, and continuous effort. Understanding public issues and finding practical solutions has been the main foundation of his working style. Empowering the youth of the society and guiding them in the right direction is among his top priorities.

aboutPage.personalDetails: According to personal details, the birth year is 1969 and the permanent address is Mundwa Road, Nagaur, Rajasthan. Regarding educational qualifications, he obtained his M.Tech degree in Information Technology and Telecommunications from the University of South Australia between 1994 and 1995. Prior to this, he completed his B.E. in Electronics Engineering from Amravati University, Maharashtra (1987-1991). His school education was completed at Bikaner Boys School, Bikaner from 1976 to 1987.

socialWork.title: Social Work & Contributions
socialWork.p1: Under his former role, he served as a member of the Board of Studies for Management at Rajasthan Technical University, Kota from 2006 to 2008.
socialWork.p2: In terms of social work, he has been actively associated with HelpAge India for the welfare of the elderly. Under healthcare, he contributed to the organization and participation of eye camps, health camps, and blood donation camps. In the field of divyang (differently-abled) service, he worked for the welfare of the blind and deaf-mute through the Blind School in Sriganganagar. Additionally, he played an active role in community participation-based programs for rural development. He encouraged rural and residential education initiatives for girls. In the direction of environmental conservation, he made a remarkable contribution by planting 1,05,000 saplings in just 3 minutes and 50 seconds in Gajsukhdesar village on August 4, 2008.
socialWork.quote: "Dedication to service, education, and society is the foundation of true success."

col1.title: Social Service & Environment
col1.text: His social work has not been limited to institutional positions. He has been actively associated with organizations like HelpAge India, Rotary Club, Lions Club, and the School for the Blind (Divyang Seva). On August 4, 2008, in village Gajsukhdesar, planting 1,05,000 saplings in just 3 minutes and 50 seconds with the participation of 15,000 villagers was a historic socio-environmental contribution of his life.

col2.title: Honour & Recognition
col2.text: For his social contributions, he was honored with the Social Responsibility Award by the Governor of Rajasthan, Smt. Pratibha Patil. Additionally, he has received accolades for girl-child education, environmental conservation, sports, and social service from various organizations, including the Swami Keshwanand Vikas Samiti.

col3.title: Personality & Vision
col3.text: Mr. Virender Choudhary's personality is built on restraint, simplicity, foresight, and institutional thinking. He believes the true value of success is realized when its benefits reach the last person in society. His life is a strong example of the balance between entrepreneurship and social responsibility. His leadership has been based on service, ethics, and inclusive development. He prioritizes national interest and social harmony over personal success. His vision inspires the building of an empowered, self-reliant, and responsible society for future generations. His life teaches that true leadership stems from humility and public welfare.

foundationPage.name: Dr. Sahdev Choudhary Foundation
aboutDesc: The primary objective of the Dr. Sahdev Choudhary Foundation is to bring positive change to society by providing an empowering, ethical, and public-interest-driven platform. The Foundation strives to bring forward youth and conscious citizens who deeply understand their real social, economic, and cultural surroundings and wish to present them with responsibility.

We firmly believe that democracy and society are strengthened only when grassroots voices and factual public issues reach the public sphere with absolute integrity. To this end, the foundation is committed to fostering civic dialogue, strengthening media ethics, and ensuring the rights and voices of marginalized communities are protected and amplified through digital media.

Through major initiatives like the Janpaksh Fellowship Program, Constitutional Knowledge Competitions, Janpaksh Conferences, and significant literary events, the foundation actively engages the community. These structured programs are designed not only to impart practical skills but also to instill a deep sense of social responsibility, media ethics, and constitutional values among the participants.

foundationPage.title: Foundation's Major Initiatives

initiatives.title: Janpaksh Fellowship Program
initiatives.desc: The Janpaksh Fellowship Program, organized on 25–26 January 2026 in Jaipur, aimed to train young journalists, digital reporters, and socially conscious citizens for responsible citizen journalism. In this two-day program, sessions were held on topics like the fundamentals of journalism, media ethics, constitutional understanding, mobile journalism, and digital content creation. This program was a structured effort towards empowering civic dialogue and public interest journalism.

initiatives.title: Constitution Knowledge Competition
initiatives.desc: On 16 December 2025, a Constitution Knowledge Competition was organized in Jayal, Nagaur (Rajasthan). More than 70 schools participated in this competition. The objective of the program was to develop an understanding among students about the values of the Indian Constitution, equality, justice, and the spirit of fraternity. Through the competition, constitutional awareness was presented in a practical and interactive way in the educational environment.

initiatives.title: Janpaksh Conference
initiatives.desc: The Janpaksh Conference was organized on 6 September 2025 at the Constitution Club. The dialogue in this conference focused on subjects related to media, society, and public discourse. The objective of the program was to provide an aggregated and serious platform for public interest discourse, where a balanced discussion on ideas, facts, and democratic values could be possible.

initiatives.title: Rajdeep Sardesai Book Launch
initiatives.desc: The book launch program of senior journalist Rajdeep Sardesai's book was held at Clarks Amer, Jaipur. During this event, dialogue took place on topics related to journalism, democracy, and contemporary public discourse. The purpose of the event was to encourage book culture and provide a serious and meaningful platform for idea-based dialogue.

sections.title: Early Life & Education
sections.desc: Mr. Virender Choudhary was born on May 1, 1969, in Rajasthan. He received his early education at Bikaner Boys School, Bikaner, where his inclination towards discipline, leadership, and social concerns developed. For higher education, he completed his graduation in Electronics Engineering (B.E.) from Amravati University, Maharashtra. To develop his technical vision on a global scale, he went to Australia, where he earned an M.Tech degree in Information Technology and Telecommunications from the University of South Australia. This international academic experience laid the foundation for his entire professional life.

sections.title: Academic & Early Professional Life
sections.desc: He began his career in the education sector as a lecturer at Maharaja Surajmal Institute of Technology, New Delhi. Following this, he worked as a consultant in the telecommunications sector with Saturn Telecommunications Limited, New Delhi. During this period, he gained a deep understanding of technical knowledge, management skills, and institutional work culture.

sections.title: Industry & Entrepreneurship
sections.desc: In 1998, he founded Nagaur Automobiles Pvt. Ltd. and started a dealership for Mahindra vehicles. Since 2000, he has been active as an authorized dealer for Tata Passenger Cars through Marwar Motors Pvt. Ltd., Bikaner. Due to his excellent customer service, institutional discipline, and quality-centric approach, he was awarded the Best Customer Service Award by Tata Motors in 2002–03 and 2005–06, which he received personally from Mr. Ratan Tata. In the industry, his identity was forged not just as a businessman, but as a reliable and value-based entrepreneur.

sections.title: Contribution to Education
sections.desc: Believing education to be the most powerful medium for social change, Mr. Chaudhary actively contributed to the establishment and management of educational institutions. He is associated with the management of Baldev Ram Mirdha Institute of Technology (BMIT), Jaipur, and BMIT East Campus. Additionally, he plays a key role in the operation of Maharani Kishori Devi Girls School, Bikaner, which specifically provides quality and safe education to rural girls. He firmly believes that girls' education is not just a social responsibility, but the cornerstone of nation-building.

sections.title: Social & Public Leadership
sections.desc: Mr. Virender Choudhary has played leadership roles in numerous social, industrial, and sports organizations. He served as the President of the Federation of Rajasthan Trade and Industry (FORTI), Bikaner, where he strengthened the dialogue between industry and government. As the President of Marubhumi Seva Avam Anusandhan Sansthan, he worked towards RTI, rural development, and environmental conservation. Alongside this, he served as the Vice President of the Rajasthan Rifle Association and President of the Nagaur Rifle Shooting Association, aiming to guide the youth in a positive direction through sports.
